An object of the present invention is to provide a method for accurately forming an antenna substrate as well as an antenna substrate with wiring line and electrode by a coating method. One aspect of the present invention provides a method for producing an antenna substrate with wiring line and electrode including the steps of: (1) forming a coating film using a photosensitive paste containing a conductive material and a photosensitive organic component on an insulating substrate; (2-A) processing the coating film into a pattern corresponding to an antenna by photolithography; (2-B) processing the coating film into a pattern corresponding to a wiring line; (2-C) processing the coating film into a pattern corresponding to an electrode; (3-A) curing the pattern corresponding to an antenna into an antenna; (3-B) curing the pattern corresponding to a wiring line into a wiring line; and (3-C) curing the pattern corresponding to an electrode into an electrode.

outputs.L1: An object of the present invention is to provide a method for accurately forming an antenna substrate, as well as an antenna substrate provided with a wiring line and an electrode, using a coating method. One aspect of the present invention provides a method for producing an antenna substrate provided with a wiring line and an electrode, the method comprising the steps of: (1) forming, on an insulating substrate, a coating film using a photosensitive paste containing a conductive material and a photosensitive organic component; (2-A) processing the coating film by photolithography to form a pattern corresponding to an antenna; (2-B) processing the coating film to form a pattern corresponding to a wiring line; (2-C) processing the coating film to form a pattern corresponding to an electrode; (3-A) curing the pattern corresponding to the antenna to form an antenna; (3-B) curing the pattern corresponding to the wiring line to form a wiring line; and (3-C) curing the pattern corresponding to the electrode to form an electrode.
outputs.L2: The present invention aims to provide both a coating-based technique for precisely fabricating an antenna substrate and an antenna substrate equipped with a wiring line and an electrode. In one embodiment, a method for manufacturing such a substrate comprises: (1) applying, to an insulating substrate, a photosensitive paste containing a conductive material and a photosensitive organic component to create a coating film; (2-A) photolithographically patterning the coating film into an antenna-shaped pattern; (2-B) patterning the coating film to define a wiring line; (2-C) patterning the coating film to define an electrode; (3-A) curing the antenna-shaped pattern to form an antenna; (3-B) curing the wiring-line pattern to produce a wiring line; and (3-C) curing the electrode pattern to produce an electrode.
outputs.L3: The invention provides a method for accurately forming an antenna substrate that includes an antenna, a wiring line, and an electrode using a coating process. First, a photosensitive paste containing a conductive material and a photosensitive organic component is applied to the surface of an insulating substrate to form a coating film. The coating film is then patterned by photolithography, producing shapes corresponding to the desired antenna, wiring line, and electrode. Finally, the patterned features are cured to produce the completed conductive components. This method enables the antenna, wiring line, and electrode to be formed with high precision through a straightforward coating and patterning process.
outputs.L4:
The invention relates to a method for accurately manufacturing an antenna substrate on which an antenna pattern, wiring lines, and electrodes are integrally formed. According to the method, a photosensitive conductive paste is applied to a surface of an insulating substrate to form a substantially uniform conductive coating. The coating is then selectively exposed to light through a photomask having patterns corresponding to the desired antenna, wiring lines, and electrodes. After exposure, the coating is developed to remove selected portions of the paste, thereby forming the respective conductive patterns with high dimensional accuracy. The patterned paste is subsequently heated or otherwise cured so that the conductive material adheres firmly to the insulating substrate and acquires the required electrical conductivity and mechanical strength.

Because the antenna, wiring lines, and electrodes are formed by photolithographic patterning of the same conductive coating, fine features and precise positional relationships can be achieved without separately mounting or aligning individual conductive components. The method therefore simplifies the fabrication process, reduces alignment errors and manufacturing variations, and enables reliable electrical connections among the antenna, wiring lines, and electrodes. As a result, a compact and highly accurate antenna substrate can be produced efficiently on a single insulating substrate.

counterfactuals.prompt: Draft a patent-style abstract describing a method for producing an antenna substrate with an antenna, wiring line, and electrode using a photosensitive conductive paste, photolithographic patterning, and curing.
counterfactuals.output: A method for producing an antenna substrate includes applying a photosensitive conductive paste to at least one surface of an insulating substrate to form a photosensitive conductive layer. The photosensitive conductive paste includes conductive particles, a photosensitive organic component, and a solvent. The conductive layer is selectively exposed to actinic radiation through a photomask having a pattern corresponding to an antenna, a wiring line, and an electrode. The exposed conductive layer is developed to remove selected portions thereof, thereby forming an uncured conductive pattern including the antenna, the wiring line electrically connected to the antenna, and the electrode electrically connected to the wiring line. The conductive pattern is subsequently cured by heating and/or irradiation to remove organic components, sinter or bond the conductive particles, and adhere the conductive pattern to the insulating substrate. Accordingly, the antenna, wiring line, and electrode can be formed with high positional accuracy and fine pattern resolution in a reduced number of manufacturing steps.
counterfactuals.label: cf_1

counterfactuals.prompt: Write an invention summary for accurately forming an antenna substrate by coating a photosensitive paste onto an insulating substrate and separately patterning and curing the antenna, wiring, and electrode.
counterfactuals.output:
### Invention Summary

The invention provides a method for manufacturing an antenna substrate with high dimensional and positional accuracy. A photosensitive paste is applied to an insulating substrate to form a photosensitive layer. Regions corresponding to an antenna pattern, a wiring pattern, and an electrode pattern are then separately exposed and developed using respective patterning masks. Each patterned region is cured independently under conditions suitable for that region, thereby forming the antenna, wiring, and electrode on the insulating substrate.

By separately patterning and curing the antenna, wiring, and electrode, the method enables individual control of their dimensions, thicknesses, shapes, and curing conditions. This suppresses pattern deformation, misalignment, and unintended electrical connection between adjacent features. Consequently, an antenna substrate having accurate fine patterns, reliable electrical continuity, and stable antenna characteristics can be manufactured efficiently.
counterfactuals.label: cf_2

counterfactuals.prompt: What might the “object of the invention” and one principal aspect be for a patent concerning fabrication of an antenna substrate with integrated wiring and electrodes by a coating method?
counterfactuals.output:
**Object of the invention:**  
To provide a simple, low-cost, and highly productive method for fabricating an antenna substrate in which antenna wiring and connection electrodes are formed with reliable electrical continuity, without requiring separate wiring and electrode-forming processes.

**One principal aspect:**  
A method comprising coating a substrate with a conductive composition in a predetermined pattern so that an antenna wiring portion and one or more electrode portions are formed integrally, followed by drying or curing the coated composition to produce the conductive antenna pattern.

counterfactuals.prompt: Generate a concise patent disclosure outlining sequential steps labeled (1), (2-A) through (2-C), and (3-A) through (3-C) for manufacturing an antenna substrate with wiring line and electrode.
counterfactuals.output:
**Patent Disclosure—Method for Manufacturing an Antenna Substrate**

A method for manufacturing an antenna substrate having an antenna wiring line and a connection electrode comprises:

**(1)** Providing an insulating substrate having a first surface and an opposing second surface.

**(2-A)** Forming a conductive seed layer on at least a portion of the first surface.

**(2-B)** Forming a patterned mask over the conductive seed layer, the patterned mask defining a wiring-line region and an electrode region.

**(2-C)** Depositing conductive material in the wiring-line region and the electrode region to integrally form an antenna wiring line and an electrode electrically connected thereto.

**(3-A)** Removing the patterned mask.

**(3-B)** Removing exposed portions of the conductive seed layer while retaining the seed layer beneath the antenna wiring line and the electrode.

**(3-C)** Applying a protective insulating layer over at least the antenna wiring line while leaving at least part of the electrode exposed, thereby obtaining the antenna substrate.
